title: Guacamole

extendedSummary: THE GREATEST guacamole recipe of all time. It is so fresh with the lemon juice, and it really helps to cut through the garlic flavour. I was shocked at how easily Mika managed to make this, and it came out restaurant quality (tasted very similar to Mamacita's guacamole). I wish I could somehow make their corn chips too that would be amazing.

items: 1 small-medium garlic clove, finely diced (big one would overpower 2 avocados, so would probs need 3)

method: Cube up the avocados then squash them with a fork until you get a uniform consistency
Finely dice your garlic clove and add that, lemon juice to the avocados
Season to taste with salt and pepper (it'll probably need a lot more seasoning than you think).
